verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Protect scoring and acting on payment transactions only: block, allow or review decisions, risk rules, risk lists and 3D Secure routing. Nothing documents scoring or managing account takeover, fake account creation, or promo and policy abuse. The optional data-collection SDK on other site pages and Shopper DNA's transaction-based shopper linking are adjacent features, not non-checkout fraud scoring.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, protection extends beyond checkout — account takeover, fake account creation, promo and policy abuse are scored and managed in the same system
